citations.narrative:
There is a shelter structure located in the lower bison pasture that is in disrepair . The churned up ground indicates that
the bison are actively utilizing this shelter structure. The structure itself has missing roof sheathing, support poles are
leaning and the building itself is moved off of the concrete blocks used to support the walls. This building is no longer
structurally sound and the roof is unstable. This building could cause injury to any bison seeking shelter within due to
falling pieces. All facilities shall be maintained to be structurally sound and maintained in good repair to protect the
animals from injury.
* To be corrected by: 9/30/2026
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representatives.
